# Theme brief: Research tab project pages

Used by `/research/*/`. Tokens: `/research/project-theme.css`. Art direction: docs/DESIGN.md, "Research".
Dark lab instrument: phosphor green `#39FF88` and amber `#FFB000` on black `#050705`, JetBrains Mono everywhere,
a graticule and scanlines in CSS, plots that draw themselves as you scroll. The RF page can reuse the tab's polar plot
(`/research/polar.js`) or the beam scene. The plot images from the repo have white backgrounds; frame them like
instrument screens. The Butler matrix plot has a transparent background with light grey text: keep it on a dark plate.
